summary: Pro Dental has a Harley Street address, clear consultation calls to action and a chat widget. Empty proof sections and dead links hurt a premium clinic where trust decides the booking.

findings.problem: The Proudly featured in logo strip shows only empty placeholder images, and the before and after images appear to be blank placeholders. No written reviews or named clinicians appear.
findings.cost: A patient choosing an implant or smile clinic on Harley Street looks for proof and for who will treat them. Empty proof sections tell them nobody has vouched for you.
findings.fix: Real media logos, captioned before and after cases, Google reviews and named clinicians.

findings.problem: About Us, Treatments, Pricing and Gallery in the menu link to #, and the Gallery link appears twice.
findings.cost: Dead menu links lose visitors who want prices or results, which are the two things patients search for first.
findings.fix: Working menu pages for each section, starting with pricing and results.

findings.problem: Booking sends the patient to an external portal (aeronaclinic.co.uk) instead of an on page form, and the Harley Street email is plain text with no link.
findings.cost: Sending a patient to a different brand's site breaks trust, and an email they cannot tap loses enquiries.
findings.fix: A booking form on your own site and tappable email and phone links.

findings.problem: The footer says Goucestershire instead of Gloucestershire, All- On-4 has a stray space, and the phone link contains spaces so it may not dial on some devices.
findings.cost: Typos and a phone link that fails make a premium clinic look careless at the moment a patient decides to call.
findings.fix: A proofread build with tested phone links.

redesign: A proof first homepage: real media logos, captioned results and Google reviews beside every booking button.
Booking on your own site with a short form, WhatsApp and chat, so a patient books in under 30 seconds.
Treatment and pricing pages written to rank for searches like dental implants Harley Street and All-on-4 London.
